name: South Forest Beach (Coligny)
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in South Forest Beach (Coligny)?
answer_short: Yes, with limits. In South Forest Beach (Coligny), a permitted, insured golf cart may use secondary roads posted 35 mph or less, in daylight, within 4 miles of its registration address. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less. Carts stay off US 278 and the Cross Island Parkway.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart at night in South Forest Beach (Coligny)?
faq.a: Not under the state default. South Carolina allows golf carts on public roads in daylight only unless a local ordinance sets other hours.

faq.q: How far can I drive a golf cart from home?
faq.a: Within 4 miles of the address on the cart's SCDMV registration, or of a gated community entrance if you live inside one.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on US 278?
faq.a: No. US 278 is a primary road, and South Carolina only allows golf carts on secondary roads posted 35 mph or less.
